realism.reason: Photoreal faces, skin, and knit texture with no obvious hand or face melt. The concourse and hotel shots are clean. Minor oddities: the hook phone is soft and partially cropped, there is a ghosted mug reflection in the window, and the empty airport looks slightly CG-sterile.

visual_consistency.reason: Earrings and the cream sweater carry through the close-ups. Hair changes from long and straight (hook) to shoulder-length waves (scene 2). In scene 3 she wears a thin white blouse and heels instead of the chunky knit. Her face in the robe shot reads slightly different and older.

brief_adherence.reason: The emotional arc matches: stress, relief, walking off, calm payoff with the sky in the upper third. However, the hook never shows the deserted gate or the carry-on at her feet, so 'stranded' relies entirely on text. The lower-phone-and-exhale beat is unclear. The protection and insurance promise only appears on the end card.

hook_strength.reason: A tight distressed face plus 'Stranded at 2am.' is relatable. Without visible airport or departure-board context, the first frame reads as someone on a phone call at night. The caption is small and low-contrast, and there is no pattern interrupt.

advertising_quality.reason: The look is polished and premium, and the relief arc is clear. The product is invisible: no app UI or claim screen, so '→ sorted by 2:05' doesn't say what was sorted or by whom. The brand appears only at 13s with no logo. The end card is a generic blurred plate with a fake-button CTA and no offer or action verb.

issues: No airport/gate or carry-on visible in the hook; 'stranded' context is text-only
Hair length and style drift between hook and scene 2
Wardrobe changes from chunky knit sweater to thin blouse with heels in the concourse shot
Face in the hotel robe scene looks like a slightly different person
Phone screen never shows the NomadGuard app, so the product role is unclear
Ghost duplicate mug reflection in the window in scene 4
Captions small and thin with weak contrast over the light sweater
End card lacks a logo; the CTA box looks like a button but has no clear action
creative.regeneration_notes: Hook: open on a medium-close shot at a deserted airport gate at night, with a departure board showing 'CANCELLED' in red soft-focus behind her and a black carry-on beside her knee. She lowers the phone from her ear and exhales. Lock character identity across all shots: same woman, long straight dark hair past the shoulders, gold hoops, cream chunky ribbed crewneck sweater, dark trousers, white sneakers (no heels). Scene 2: include an over-shoulder insert of the phone screen showing a clean NomadGuard app card reading 'Hotel booked · Covered' with a check mark. Scene 3: keep the chunky knit sweater visible from behind. Scene 4: use the same face and hair as the reference (hair tied back is fine), and avoid duplicate reflections in the window. Text: increase caption size and weight and add a subtle shadow or pill background. End card: add the NomadGuard logo mark and an explicit CTA such as 'Get covered in 2 minutes'.
